digest.component_or_area: gate resolution and operator error handling (verify.* opt-in gates)
propositions: gate_enabled must raise ConfigError on unreadable rebar.toml instead of returning GateState.UNREADABLE or silently proceeding
claim and transition operations must fail loudly with that error at the point of gate resolution, before any work or write-lock acquisition
GateState.UNREADABLE is removed; existing readable-config behavior (ENABLED/DISABLED resolution, disabled skip verdict, gate_ran stamp, bool monkeypatch) stays unchanged
CLI main() must catch ConfigError and render it as a clean operator-facing error message (exit 1) not a traceback
unreadable config at operation start results in neither a silent skip nor a fail-closed blocked gate; it surfaces the parse fault loudly so the operator can fix it
